tools.name: download
tools.description: Download a file to a local directory. Provide md5 (book), isbn (book), doi (article); at least one is required. Books are tried by md5 against libgen then randombook then annas. Books are tried by isbn against oapen then archive, which serve openly licensed copies only. Articles are tried by doi aga

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Full metadata for a bibliographic record — description, identifiers, DOI, cover, related edition — plus ready-to-paste BibTeX and RIS exports in its citations field. Use it whenever you are asked to cite or reference a work. A record's DOI reaches those exports only once corroborated against Crossre

tools.name: read
tools.description: Extract and paginate the text of a book or paper so you can read it without downloading the whole file. tools.name: search
tools.description:
Federated search for books, papers, comics, magazines and standards across multiple bibliographic catalogs and open-access sources, returning results with metadata, md5 hash and download options.

The primary catalog (Library Genesis) is queried first. The search also reaches BEYOND it: Anna's Archi

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "download" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
